The History of Brett/Robinson — Established 1968

Over 50 years ago, brothers Tillis and Gene Brett and Tommy Robinson built Brett/Robinson with hard work, integrity, perseverance, and faith.

The Early Years

Before Brett/Robinson, Tillis and Gene Brett started with $500 to form Brett Real Estate. In 1968, they teamed up with builder Tommy Robinson to create Brett Real Estate Robinson Development Co Inc., incorporated in 1974 in Saraland, Alabama.

Their journey began in Chickasaw, Alabama, with door-to-door sales. This led to a partnership with Tommy, a subdivision developer and hardware store owner. Their sales and building expertise fueled rapid growth, driven by commitment to employees and customers.

Weathering the Storms

Despite four recessions, disasters, and real estate shifts, the Brett and Robinson families stayed strong. Their American spirit and dedicated team helped them thrive where others failed.

“The people made the company and it starts right here. We’re dedicated.”

— Tillis Brett, 2016

“Our great associates and employees over the years have been a great team. That’s what makes it — our commitment, dedication, hard work and, of course, the fact that we never thought about quitting or giving up.”

— Gene Brett

The Phoenix Rises

In 1985, the first Phoenix condominium rose from a burned-down beach house in Orange Beach. During the savings and loan crisis, the team built trust with condo owners, always honoring commitments.

The name “Phoenix” came from Gene Brett, inspired by the mythical bird symbolizing resilience.

“We thought that was a crazy name… but it just caught on. And Gene pushed pretty hard, he would not back off of it.”

— Tommy Robinson

The Legacy Continues

Today, Brett/Robinson manages over a thousand homes and dozens of condo projects. The next generation leads with the same values of hard work, integrity, and family near Gulf Shores Alabama hotels.

Events in Gulf Shores & Orange Beach

Year-Round Events on the Alabama Gulf Coast

From seafood festivals and live music to air shows and holiday markets, Gulf Shores and Orange Beach host memorable events in every season. Stay close to the action in our Gulf Shores Alabama hotels, condos, and resorts.

Winter Events

 

Seafood Festival & Car Show 

Enjoy live music, 100+ artists, classic cars, and a Kids’ Zone every February at The Wharf.

 

Ballyhoo Festival 

Explore juried fine art, live music, and Poarch Creek Indian culture at Gulf State Park.

 

Mardi Gras Parades 

Catch colorful land and boat parades in February, close to Gulf Shores Alabama resorts.

Spring Events

 

Orange Beach Festival of Art 

Enjoy fine art, live music, culinary demos, and kids’ activities on the Back Bay in March.

 

Wharf Boat & Yacht Show 

See top marine brands, boats, and fishing gear during this premier March show at The Wharf.

 

Zydeco Crawfish Festival 

Savor Louisiana-style crawfish and Zydeco music each April at Gulf Shores’ Waterway Village.

 

Interstate Mullet Toss 

Join the legendary late-April beach party and mullet-throwing contest at the Flora-Bama.

Summer Events

 

Hangout Music Festival 

Vibe with top artists at this massive May beachfront music festival in Gulf Shores.

 

Wharf Amphitheater Concerts 

Enjoy big-name concerts from May through October at The Wharf in Orange Beach.

 

Blue Marlin Grand Championship 

Experience the excitement of this July fishing tournament and weigh-in party at The Wharf.

 

Alabama Coastal Triathlon 

Race in the Olympic and sprint triathlon each September, presented by Brett/Robinson.

 

Bulls on the Beach 

Watch three nights of thrilling bull riding on the sand at the Flora-Bama in September.

Fall & Holiday Events

 

Freedom Festival 

Celebrate with classic cars, crafts, live music, and military appreciation in October.

 

Shrimp Festival 

Enjoy four days of live music, coastal art, and fresh Gulf Coast seafood in October.

 

Blue Angels Air Show 

Watch a spectacular November flyover in nearby Pensacola or along the Alabama coast.

 

Frank Brown Songwriters Festival 

Celebrate songwriting with intimate performances across the Gulf Coast for two weeks each November.

 

Holly Days on Main 

Shop a festive holiday market with a lighted boat parade, performances, and family fun in December.

Beach Rentals on the Alabama Gulf Coast

The Alabama Gulf Coast is a hidden gem for beach lovers—stunning shoreline, warm hospitality, and rental options that feel like home with modern amenities.

Summary

The Alabama Gulf Coast pairs less-crowded, family-friendly beaches with rich outdoor activities and warm local hospitality. Gulf Shores and Orange Beach headline the rental scene, offering beachfront locations, modern amenities, and easy access to attractions. Options range from cozy condos to spacious beach houses and luxury villas—many pet-friendly—with conveniences like full kitchens, pools, and high-speed Wi-Fi. Book early, compare prices and reviews, and look for deals to secure the ideal stay.

Why Choose the Alabama Gulf Coast for Your Beach Vacation?

The Alabama Gulf Coast is known for breathtaking scenery and a laid-back vibe. Travelers appreciate the stunning beaches and the easygoing pace that makes it ideal for a true escape.

This destination is rich in outdoor activities for all ages—fishing, boating, and exploring local parks—so it works equally well for relaxation and adventure.

Key reasons to visit

	Less crowded beaches
	Family-friendly activities
	Local hospitality and culture

Visitors also enjoy vibrant sunsets and diverse dining—perfect for making lasting memories.

Top Destinations: Gulf Shores and Orange Beach Rentals

Gulf Shores and Orange Beach are top picks for vacation rentals on the Alabama Gulf Coast. Each offers its own unique appeal and attractions.

Gulf Shores
